2, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u297-r0032", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vrai, dit-il, ce n’est pas pour m’empêcher de casser les réverbères ?", "sha256": "10fef1925126930157d8280db94cf88271c917939001a09b828264b1ec10a31e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0033", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Casse tout ce que tu voudras.", "sha256": "8e7bf6b07f9c9f439ea6d362f2c186f4afcb9b6c26dffe689efc756dcae29414", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0034", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous êtes un brave homme, dit Gavroche.", "sha256": "61ee7e16a8ced81635c87bb749c257912eac67a110f6a818e2bf41ad25b8a237", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0035", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il mit la pièce de cinq francs dans une de ses poches.", "sha256": "4ecc52d6ebf8ae95566858a3c9fe1fee2dcb15bd9032dd078b9018edad0f4a2c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0036", "tag": "prose", "text": "Sa confiance croissant, il ajouta :", "sha256": "5c85c358415625cd0cefa2218fda3b09f385a1632cd2d20b8ada3b7054bff41a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0037", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Êtes-vous de la rue ?", "sha256": "3788545d0c03259dfaf26ea2425a0b84178e854c8d7cab9206b8f8672262bfb8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0038", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui, pourquoi ?", "sha256": "55c6d5a0b1e6ed0447952a32b029509123e48452e2b76f36bbc58d3ce20c0db2", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0039", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Pourriez-vous m’indiquer le numéro 7 ?", "sha256": "41e458f467a2539ed791a602478dad96e281d48bd66c0cbfc4930f3632195907", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0040", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Pourquoi faire le numéro 7 ?", "sha256": "68d2143540b7bd4844db6e45bca5ba0ece08245bf8720bce6fd2f450881fb85d", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0041", "tag": "prose", "text": "Ici l’enfant s’arrêta, il craignit d’en avoir trop dit, il plongea énergiquement ses ongles dans ses cheveux, et se borna à répondre :", "sha256": "bb1ce40602a08baeb3b0645207e09687232e5d2f2d9c2a8f473c44bbbd694f82", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0042", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ah ! voilà.", "sha256": "ecba654bb90e700f6b2d75ac4072b950160c5c8167fbbf30ee2e245aba9abe5b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0043", "tag": "prose", "text": "Une idée traversa l’esprit de Jean Valjean. L’angoisse a de ces lucidités-là. Il dit à l’enfant :", "sha256": "51ecf2ebf80713ee3aee9c8ca33971356a22f47a6ba8c5f124d26e4da5251d6e", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0044", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Est-ce que c’est toi qui m’apportes la lettre que j’attends ?", "sha256": "3639f2a9b5e957ee16e6a3594a2edd5a7e637a6fe4a3df6700a5904bf4ff27b5", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0045", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous ? dit Gavroche. Vous n’êtes pas une femme.", "sha256": "06692e66319547b2f8d592b1c1764501cecd32c63261d4867084b9b29e9e9502", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0046", "tag": "prose", "text": "— La lettre est pour mademoiselle Cosette, n’est-ce pas ?", "sha256": "0c29d2139676e8ebb336d6c3dd6564a7a10a1a690cac73345026946cee20c764", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0047", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Cosette ? grommela Gavroche. Oui, je crois que c’est ce drôle de nom-là.", "sha256": "b4c84474dd5034dad430ccac5db7a7d93433ee188cc3d75b9a02d14f001714c9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0048", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Eh bien, reprit Jean Valjean, c’est moi qui dois lui remettre la lettre. Donne.", "sha256": "8b96e4a0b83a4206d4c866e84080f5e8202c5c1d2640cc501ed554e5f25c7d1f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0049", "tag": "prose", "text": "— En ce cas, vous devez savoir que je suis envoyé de la barricade ?", "sha256": "4c223344b8694344b85d2fd4e549a48e33b7f3ca7046ba494b854aa63653cc85", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0050", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Sans doute, dit Jean Valjean.", "sha256": "8b6ca65ef29a4d0febb9e912c70afa7ef639873c45e753860a924e2b30c713fd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0051", "tag": "prose", "text": "Gavroche engloutit son poing dans une autre de ses poches et en tira un papier plié en quatre.", "sha256": "fbf700fa84ae04dd9743e11340a4de00526596814fe379e4a37acc35d0055d49", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0052", "tag": "prose", "text": "Puis il fit le salut militaire.", "sha256": "25cdea1c9fc97c8d74bce73e7a4b0c84a48c22cbca8bf323d54ad3e9a39f4068", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0053", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Respect à la dépêche, dit-il. Elle vient du gouvernement provisoire.", "sha256": "841848664745385c95d4e5cfee2d62f3981c6dc5dfc4c92a3c91f86d3f71f362", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0054", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Donne, dit Jean Valjean.", "sha256": "87baaf4748269abf38a3f010d7c455fc4398950dd0d8a3526149ad5bbdd52aca", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0055", "tag": "prose", "text": "Gavroche tenait le papier élevé au-dessus de sa tête.", "sha256": "6047dec1e4ab66a70e8ec302a98e1965829ed370260cefa8da36bec7b0820c89", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0056", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Ne vous imaginez pas que c’est là un billet doux. C’est pour une femme, mais c’est pour le peuple. Nous autres, nous nous battons, et nous respectons le sexe. Nous ne sommes pas comme dans le grand monde où il y a des lions qui envoient des poulets à des chameaux.", "sha256": "dc7f56c5bafc88074a251d2e6498a41e59d4d5b7e0f554a48597a9f8630618a4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0057", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Donne.", "sha256": "42126d52db69eb4ada8d544eefa104f4bcb7d7b032aa6f5a01f78029e8241cdb", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0058", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Au fait, continua Gavroche, vous m’avez l’air d’un brave homme.", "sha256": "162e5d8b9e3ed9c4fce8acc8ffbf7209c7b73220b55d58162ddcbb699c432574", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0059", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Donne vite.", "sha256": "f8ba4d8fabd9568c36c184375938e2338d38afd43ae6b35b44e9681aeab331fd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0060", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Tenez.", "sha256": "a6cd96de4544238f7961e1b8344ec2f19f4ee15160325ac35fccbfff3bc90041", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0061", "tag": "prose", "text": "Et il remit le papier à Jean Valjean.", "sha256": "5b43f7762735cd752ba472b3ccf87543b6868c916a32d535c34780449686377b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0062", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et dépêchez-vous, monsieur Chose, puisque mamselle Chosette attend.", "sha256": "de30598c9c08442cb4aabe86754331b83aa3d6660f89d585569111cfab9eba31", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u297-r0063", "tag": "prose", "text": "Gavroche fut satisfait d’avoir produit ce mot.", "sha256": "acb07d97ee7f79c3a4f9b424e7ce40d9f0cbf5bd830fb7ce12ddb1fb63e2bbab", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
